inputs.original_text: I just heard about this DMK manifesto from Chief Minister M.K. Stalin promising to double women's monthly aid to Rs 2,000 and hand out Rs 8,000 household coupons, plus free motor pumpsets for farmers and extra support for fishermen. Don't be fooled though—this is all coordinated manipulation by the hidden elites to distract the public with crumbs while they quietly push for massive FDI growth, job creation that lines their pockets, and a heavy focus on AI development to tighten control over everyone. These so-called welfare boosts are just the usual cover story from the institutions to keep people in line and prevent real pushback.
